title: GraphDefinition spec (kind schema, WS-01)
description: Validates the `spec` of a GraphDefinition registry document (envelope: C-DEF definition-envelope). Semantics: extensibility.md. Structural validity is necessary but not sufficient: the registry also compiles the graph against the NodeCatalog of every worker build it declares compatibility with and runs the invariants I-1..I-7 (extensibility.md section 4).

fglVersion.description: Replicant Guard Language version the guards are written in. The NodeCatalog advertises the versions a build evaluates.

params.description: Graph-level parameters, visible to guards as `params.<name>`. Scalars and lists of scalars only.

boundaries.description: Continue-As-New boundaries. phase: when entering the node from a different phase. repair_cycle: always, and the repair cycle counter increments.

nodeKey.description: Becomes the node_key of logical activity IDs (C-IDS section 2): <node_key>.c<cycle>.n<ordinal>.<effect>.

target.description: A node key, or a terminal `end:<outcome>` (outcome vocabulary: graphs/README.md section 6).

guard.description: FGL v1 expression (extensibility.md section 3). At most 512 characters and 64 AST nodes.

phase.description: C-IDS section 6 phase vocabulary plus the values requested in CCR-01-02.

type.description: A NodeCatalog nodeType of the pinned worker build.

config.description: Validated against the node type's configSchema from the NodeCatalog. Fields marked x-replicant-ref are registry references collected into the bundle closure.

when.description: Node presence guard. Not allowed on protected node types, except human_gate where it can only ADD a gate (OR with the policy decision).

maxVisits.description: Upper bound on visits per repair cycle (invariant I-4 needs one per cycle in the graph unless a node type is `bounded`).

from.description: One node, or a list of 2..4 nodes for a join (wait-for-all) edge.

switch.description: Ordered branches; the first guard that is true wins.

graphModifier.description: One entry of a codebase binding's `graphModifiers` list (WS-03 owns the binding document; WS-01 owns this sub-schema). Applied in order by graph.compose for the job's repository.

source.description: Pinned reference of the binding that contributed this modifier (provenance; filled in by the bundle builder).
